task_instance: Gate a UI screen (a sample React 'Pricing' component plus its CSS) before it is called done: run the skill's three deterministic stdlib gates end to end - finish_lint on the source, state_matrix_checker on a state-coverage CSV for the screen, and rendered_audit on a rendered-page snapshot - and record the verdicts in the sign-off.
evidence: Copied the skill's scripts/assets/references into the work dir (no modification of the source repo). Wrote a realistic defective screen src/Pricing.tsx + src/pricing.css (inert onClick, href '#', 'Lorem ipsum', '$XX', outline removed) and a state-coverage CSV states.csv. All three core stdlib Python scripts ran under python3 3.13 with no network: (1) 'python3 scripts/finish_lint.py src/' -> 'BLOCKED (2 files; 6 blocker, 1 high, 7 warn; generic risk HIGH)', exit 4, correctly flagging PLACEHOLDER_COPY x2, INERT_HANDLER, FOCUS_REMOVED x2, DEAD_LINK, BUTTON_NO_ACTION and 6 TEMPLATE_DEFAULT warnings; a clean control file returned 'CLEAN', exit 0 - so the gate is real, not always-blocking. (2) 'python3 scripts/state_matrix_checker.py --matrix states.csv' -> 'BLOCKED (3 surfaces, 71% covered; 3 blocker, 3 high)', exit 4, flagging MISSING_BLOCKING empty/error/validation_error, DONE_NO_EVIDENCE and NA_NO_REASON. (3) 'python3 scripts/rendered_audit.py --snapshot assets/snapshot.example.json' -> 'BLOCKED (6 blocker, 2 high, 1 warn)', exit 4, flagging TEXT_CONTRAST, NO_FOCUS_INDICATOR, FOCUS_OBSCURED, REFLOW_SCROLL, NO_ACCESSIBLE_NAME, TARGET_TOO_SMALL. Independently reproduced the WCAG relative-luminance contrast math by importing the module (p.hint gray-on-white = 2.54:1 FAIL vs 4.5 threshold; h1 = 17.74:1 pass), matching the script output. Filled finish_signoff.filled.md from the three verdict lines. Verified deliverable = the three gating scripts actually run and gate correctly on real inputs. The only part not exercisable offline is the OPTIONAL Playwright keyboard-pass capture (assets/capture_snapshot.mjs): Playwright is not installed and installing/capturing needs the network and a live URL; the skill marks this optional and rendered_audit runs on a supplied snapshot instead, so the core deliverable is unaffected. Files produced: src/Pricing.tsx, src/pricing.css, clean/Ok.tsx, states.csv, finish_signoff.filled.md, all under the work dir.
